title: The Scientist Who Dissolved His Own Organs With a Single Touch
hook: A chemist synthesized a compound so corrosive it seeped through his gloves and turned his internal organs into liquid over three weeks.
why_this_can_go_viral: Combines body horror with a real lab fatality, triggering visceral disgust and morbid curiosity.

title: The Physicist Who Turned a Room Into a Time Loop—With Lasers
hook: A quantum optics experiment trapped photons in a feedback loop, and they started arriving before the laser fired.
why_this_can_go_viral: Time loops are universally fascinating; the implication of broken causality creates deep curiosity.

title: The Lab Catastrophe Where a Chemical Reaction Created a Cloud of Acid
hook: A chemist mixed two safe liquids—and the resulting aerosol dissolved the lab's ventilation system and burned lungs from 50 feet away.
why_this_can_go_viral: Visual horror of an invisible killing cloud that spreads through air conditioning is immediately gripping.

title: The Physicist Who Created a 'Dark Wave' That Absorbed All Light
hook: A metamaterial experiment produced a waveform that swallowed photons—the lab went pitch black for 0.3 seconds.
why_this_can_go_viral: The idea of a man-made 'darkness' that eats light is visually striking and conceptually mind-blowing.

title: The Biolab That Grew a 'Feeling' Tumor With Eyes and Teeth
hook: Stem cell researchers accidentally created a teratoma that developed a primitive nervous system—and it reacted to touch.
why_this_can_go_viral: Body horror at its peak—a living mass that can feel pain in a petri dish; deeply unsettling yet fascinating.

title: The Chemist Who Made a 'Forever Gas' That Poisons the Next Century
hook: A failed synthesis created a chlorofluorocarbon variant that breaks down ozone for 500 years—and it's still leaking somewhere.
why_this_can_go_viral: Horrifying legacy of a single mistake that will outlive everyone; apocalyptic time-scale resonates.

title: The Lab Catastrophe Where a Mutated Bacteria Ate a Researcher's Feet
hook: A petri dish of Pseudomonas aeruginosa evolved to digest human keratin—and an open wound led to necrotic feet in 48 hours.
why_this_can_go_viral: Graphic, real medical horror that feels like a zombie movie but happened in a real lab.

title: The Physicist Who Built a 'Zero Friction' Surface That Never Stopped Moving
hook: A superfluid coating allowed a metal disc to spin for 47 years—and it's still going in a sealed chamber underground.
why_this_can_go_viral: Perpetual motion fascinates everyone; the idea of a hidden object spinning for decades is eerie and cool.

title: The Scientific Fraud Who Faked a 'Cancer Cure'—With Sugar Water and Lies
hook: A biochemist published 12 papers on a miracle compound that shrank tumors—it was just glucose solution with a pH buffer.
why_this_can_go_viral: Exploits hope of millions; the betrayal and anger at fake cures drives high emotional engagement.

title: The Biolab That Created a 'Self-Replicating' Protein That Clogged Everything
hook: A prion-like protein designed for nanotech began folding incorrectly and turned an entire lab's fluid systems into gel.
why_this_can_go_viral: Nightmare scenario of a self-spreading biological agent; parallels to 'The Blob' and real prion diseases.

title: The Quantum Paradox Where a Particle 'Remembered' Its Future State
hook: In a delayed-choice experiment, photons behaved as if they knew what measurement would be made—before it happened.
why_this_can_go_viral: Suggests time might be an illusion; the idea of particles 'knowing' the future blows minds.

title: The Forbidden Experiment Where They Made a 'Human-Plant' Hybrid
hook: Scientists fused human stem cells with plant chloroplasts—the resulting organism produced oxygen and had human DNA.
why_this_can_go_viral: Transgresses the ultimate boundary between animal and plant; grotesque and awe-inspiring in equal measure.

title: The Lab Catastrophe Where a Synchrotron Beam Vaporized a Researcher's Hand
hook: A particle accelerator safety interlock failed—the high-energy X-ray beam incinerated flesh in milliseconds, leaving only ash.
why_this_can_go_viral: Brutal, almost sci-fi horror of a beam that turns bone to dust; pure shock value and real-world lesson.

title: The Physicist Who Created a 'Magnetic Cage' That Trapped a Plasma Star
hook: A tokamak experiment accidentally confined a 100-million-degree plasma ball that glowed like a miniature sun—and it wouldn't stop.
why_this_can_go_viral: Creating a star on Earth is inherently awesome; the danger of a runaway plasma ball adds tension.

title: The Scientific Fraud Who Faked a 'Brain Transplant' in Rabbits
hook: A Soviet surgeon claimed he kept a rabbit head alive for 3 days—it was actually a dog's head with prosthetic eyes and a hidden pump.
why_this_can_go_viral: Grim and macabre—the image of a living severed head is unforgettable; outrage at the cruelty drives shares.

title: The Neuroscientist Who Found That Your Brain Has a 'Silent Voice' That Never Sleeps
hook: fMRI scans revealed a continuous inner monologue region that activates even during deep sleep—and it never stops talking.
why_this_can_go_viral: Everyone has an inner voice; learning it never shuts up is creepy and deeply personal—high relatability.

title: The Biolab That Created a 'Corpse Flower' That Smells Like Rotting Flesh—and It Moved
hook: A genetically modified Rafflesia plant not only emits cadaverine—it can curl its petals to trap insects like a Venus flytrap.
why_this_can_go_viral: Mixes botanical horror with predatory behavior; the foul smell and movement create a visceral reaction.
